day5_after_cage_3.text:
*She covers the bottom field of the attendance register and smiles.*

You don't have anything else to ask me now, do you? I've answered. You don't need to show me that box again.

day5_after_cage_5.text:
*Ms. Eunsu takes me by the shoulders and turns me back toward my seat. Her fingertips are cold.*

I can walk. You don't need to hold my shoulder. I said I'd go back. I remember my seat.

day5_after_cage_6.text:
*I return to the classroom and sit down. Sea sits beside me, and Nurse Riin hands me some tea. Everyone is smiling.*

Take the tea. Stay right here. Your seat hasn't changed.

day5_after_cage_7.text: {name}, all you have to do is stay here, in the seat assigned to you in the attendance book.

day5_after_cage_8.text: *I set down the cup midway through my tea. Between the sounds of water, I hear 'Run.' Then it’s gone.*

day5_after_cage_9.text: *Everyone smiles almost at the same time. It’s an unfamiliar sight, but my grip on the cup loosens.*

day5_after_cage_10.text: *The word I was trying to recall slips off the tip of my tongue. My name is in the attendance book.*

day5_after_caught_1.text: *I open my eyes. Flickering fluorescent lights. A concrete ceiling. The basement.*

day5_after_caught_2.text: *I try to move my hands. They won't budge. Leather straps bind me to a chair.*

day5_after_caught_3.text: *The same chair. The same straps. The same fluorescent light. A layout I saw first in the dream.*

day5_after_caught_5.text: ...You attempted deviation? Do you know how dangerous that is?

day5_after_caught_6.text: I'll prepare the final checkup. Just need to draw blood and hook up the IV.

day5_after_caught_7.text:
*Nurse Riin disinfects the inside of my elbow. The alcohol swab feels cold against my skin. I tense my wrist.*

My checkup? Is tying me up part of a checkup?

day5_after_caught_resist_1.text: *I tense my whole body. The leather straps dig into my wrists. I keep straining against them.*

day5_after_caught_resist_2.text: No! Let go! Don't tell me to stay still; undo these straps. Do you think I'll listen with you tying me down?

day5_after_caught_resist_3.text: If you move, it's dangerous. Stay still—

day5_after_caught_resist_4.text: *The power went out, and the fluorescent lights went dark.*

day5_after_caught_resist_5.text: *In the dark, someone touches my wrist. Seolhwa’s face seems to overlap with what I see, but the hand undoing the knot is mine. My fingers work quickly between the knots.*

day5_after_caught_resist_6.text: *My left hand finds the buckle first, even though I can't see it. My fingers retrace a path they have followed before.*

day5_after_caught_resist_7.text: *I run through the dark. My fingertips follow scratches in the wall, and my feet turn toward the emergency exit.*

day5_after_caught_submit_1.text: *The strength drains out. The leather straps no longer hurt. My head drops and my eyes close.*

day5_after_caught_submit_2.text: *The syringe touches my arm. The needle goes in. Cold liquid spreads through my veins.*

day5_after_caught_submit_3.text: *My body grows warm. My thoughts blur.*

day5_after_caught_submit_4.text: *One name slips away. Not even the first syllable remains.*

day5_after_confront_1.text: *From behind — footsteps. Coming up the stairs. One step. One step. Slow. Not running.*

day5_after_confront_2.text: *The footsteps grow closer. The sound of dress shoes hitting concrete. Ms. Eunsu's shoes.*

day5_after_confront_3.text:
*The sound of dress shoes stops at the end of the stairs. Ms. Eunsu appears, out of breath and with her hair disheveled.*

Tired from chasing me? Then rest here. If you want to take me back, you should hear why I'm refusing first.

day5_after_confront_4.text:
*On the landing, she catches her breath and opens her mouth without smiling.*

I'll catch my breath too. It's hard to talk while running away. But don't grab me before you've heard me.

day5_after_confront_5.text: {name}. Stop there. The emergency exit side is a restricted area.

day5_after_confront_6.text:
*As I back away, Ms. Eunsu moves the syringe in front of her body. The needle flashes briefly beneath the emergency light.*

The exit isn't blocking us. You are. Put that down and talk.

day5_after_confront_7.text: *Eunsu’s forehead is wet, and the skin beneath her eyes is dark. A cold wind comes through the emergency exit.*

day5_after_confront_8.text: Every chart had the same four fields. Deviation. Tracking. Recovery. Reset.

day5_after_confront_9.text: The 1st time, I was angry. The 2nd time, I tried to find the cause.

day5_after_confront_10.text: From the third time on, I hated the next morning more than the day you ran. You never recognized me.

day5_after_confront_11.text: So I started by locking the doors. People, the app, even the route to school.

day5_after_confront_12.text: I removed the sounds you hated first. Food, seats, even the order of conversations. The numbers improved.

day5_after_confront_13.text: On day 1, when you walked into the classroom, my pen snagged on the paper twice, even though it was the same form.

day5_after_confront_14.text: I thought I’d get used to it. But every time you failed to recognize me, I couldn’t finish the sentences in my report.

day5_after_confront_15.text:
*Ms. Eunsu steps away from the emergency exit and stops about 3 meters from me. She takes a syringe from her pocket.*

I knew you'd bring that out. Do you want me to become a stranger again?

day5_after_confront_16.text: *The liquid inside the syringe glittered under the fluorescent light. On the label, in tiny letters, it said `RESET / S-13`.*

day5_after_confront_17.text: Make your choice now, {name}. One shot, and you’ll forget the documents you saw today. Your reactions will be back within the baseline range.

day5_after_confront_18.text: Once your memories are wiped, you can start again on Monday morning. Day 1. Come back to the classroom.

day5_after_confront_19.text:
*A drop of liquid falls from the syringe’s tip onto the floor. Ms. Eunsu does not lower her hand.*

Stop telling me to return. I want to leave through that door.

day5_after_confront_20.text: *A drop trembles on the tip of the syringe. Wind enters from the emergency exit. Below the stairs, Seolhwa stands in silence.*

day5_after_final_choice.text: *I could push past her. But my body is already leaning toward the classroom.*

day5_after_true_1.text: *Ms. Eunsu's hand trembles. The syringe fell to the floor. Glass shattered against the tile.*

day5_after_true_2.text: ...okay. It's the door again this time.

day5_after_true_3.text:
*She shuts her eyes and steps aside.*

Yuna, now. Go to the door. I'm right behind you.

day5_after_true_4.text: *I passed through the emergency exit. With Yuna. The fire escape behind the old wing.*

day5_after_true_5.text: *The late-night air is cold. A road is visible beyond the school fence. I look back.*

day5_after_true_6.text:
*Seolhwa is standing inside the emergency exit. She can't step outside the door.*

Don't stand in the doorway, come with us. Could you get out if I held your hand? Don't stay there on your own.

day5_after_true_9.text: *The emergency light passes through her smiling face and lights the tiles behind her.*

day5_after_true_10.text: Every one of those six attempts stopped here. Today, just go.

day5_after_true_11.text: My record ends here. You go through the door.

day5_after_true_11a.text: Lee Seolhwa. I’ll remember that name.

day5_after_true_12.text: *Seolhwa's outline scatters. The smell of rainy stairs, a wet school-uniform sleeve, the cold hand that held my left hand all rush in at once.*

day5_after_forget_3.text: All those blanks are my records, aren’t they?

day5_after_forget_4.text: I don’t think I can handle that fact.

day5_after_forget_5.text: Please erase me. Make me forget everything.

day5_after_forget_6.text:
*Ms. Eunsu raises the syringe and brings it toward my arm.*

I don't want to watch. Can I close my eyes? I can't look at your face or the needle any longer.

day5_after_forget_8.text: *The needle entered my arm. Cold. Consciousness fades.*

day5_after_forget_9.text: *The last thing I see is Seolhwa. Her mouth moves, but no sound reaches me.*

day5_after_forget_12.text: *Only the hum of the fluorescent light remains.*

day5_after_resist_2.text: This probably isn’t your first signature. But you shouldn’t sign any more.

day5_after_resist_4.text: No. From the 3rd time on, it was my choice.

day5_after_resist_5.text: Every signature after that is in my handwriting, {name}.

day5_after_resist_6.text: If you stay here, another student will end up in that seat.

day5_after_resist_7.text: *My feet stop. Seolhwa appears, not behind Eunsu but superimposed over my vision.*

day5_after_resist_9.text: Every time a new name tag appeared, you smiled the same way. A little less each time.

day5_after_resist_10.text: ...You need to leave too, Ms. Eunsu.

day5_after_resist_11.text:
*She sets the syringe on the floor and stands there for a long time.*

Leave it there. Now use that hand to open the door.

day5_after_resist_12.text: ...Once I go outside, every document will have my name on it.

day5_after_resist_13c.text: The 11th Oh Taehyun... said he trusted me. That it was all right because I was his teacher.

day5_after_resist_13d.text:
*Ms. Eunsu can’t finish the sentence. She closes her mouth.*

He trusted you. What did you do? Stopping there doesn't mean I don't know what came after.

day5_after_resist_13e.text: ...I erased it that night. The next morning, that student asked, 'Who are you, teacher?'

day5_after_resist_13f.text: Even so, I signed. On the next line, and the one after that.

day5_after_resist_13g.text: ...I erased you with my own hands. And yet?

day5_after_resist_14.text:
*She covers her mouth and can’t go on speaking for a while.*

I heard you. I didn't only want an apology. You kept writing, and you're stopping now. Those are both things you've done.

day5_after_resist_15.text: If these documents get out, you’ll be held accountable. But that’s better than writing the next line here.

day5_after_ghost_1.text: *My toes won't lift, as if they're stuck to the floor.*

day5_after_ghost_5.text: Six times, no one made it through this door. This time, I’ll stop Eunsu.

day5_after_ghost_6.text: When the door opens, I’ll push you straight through.

day5_after_ghost_7.text:
*Seolhwa looks straight at me. I’ve never seen that look in any of the photos so far.*

Look outside, not at me. If you go first, I'll follow. Are you looking at me like that because you mean to send only me out?

day5_after_ghost_9.text:
*My body moved. My toes turned toward the emergency exit. I took Yuna's hand and ran.*

Yuna, don't let go. We'll get through the door together. Don't go back when they call. Stay with me now.

day5_after_ghost_10.text: *A shout follows me from behind, but I don’t stop. After Yuna and I pass through the emergency exit, I look back. Seolhwa is smiling inside the doorway.*

day5_after_ghost_11.text: ...teacher. Next, there is no name tag.

day5_after_ghost_12.text: *She disappears. At the same moment, an alarm sounds inside the building.*

day5_after_ghost_13.text: *The building erupted in noise. Sirens, footsteps, shouting. I could no longer hear Seolhwa's voice. I got out of the school.*
